name: horrific visage
desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=v8KiqUloIE5eocSu]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=v8KiqUloIE5eocSu]]-foot Cone that can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and isn't an Undead. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Horrifying Visage for 24 hours.
